shown.message:
I updated the outline to revision 3 to match Brief revision 5. It is pushed to the story-repo wiki.

Revision 5 adopted the review's point about the diagnostic. On equal-degree cells, a tie between leverage and the degree-only benchmarks is expected. Part (i) is now judged only on a fixed set D of cells where the two make different predictions. Those are the heterogeneous-degree graphs (BA, DC-SBM and the two real graphs), degree- or community-correlated baselines, cluster designs, and the specification ladder inside a cell. Leave-one-family-out for part (i) uses only the four D families, so power is low and per-group results will be shown. Figure 7 will mark D cells and tie cells differently and give the ladder comparison its own panel.

The Brief's cell budget still lacks the additions from the review, such as the fine s grid, the n slice and the coverage outputs. They stay in my outline for `analysis` to cost and cut.
